faq.q: How is a titanium dive watch crown manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium dive watch crown is manufactured using CNC milling; Diamond-cut beveling; PVD coating (ISO 27874, Delta-E <=1.0); Oleophobic AFP nano-coating. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Manual machining (lower precision, longer setup time).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: Titanium Dive Watch Crown components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium dive watch crown?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
